name: Unraid
summary: HTTP 80 passed through, with the dashboard's live updates kept open.
notes: The dashboard streams updates over long-lived connections, so a short server timeout makes it look frozen. Unraid is usually reached over plain HTTP on the local network; if you have enabled its SSL, point the target at https:// instead and the certificate will not be verified. Restrict who can reach this -- it administers the whole machine.
